Native decode lane (agent://88-CleanG002Native) confirmed both blockers fixed (B1 first-connection nonzero-epoch adoption, B2 same-epoch reset poisoning) plus A1-A4 advisories; its one residual LOW finding (trailing-reset poison discard) was subsequently fixed by the parent with drain_newest returning Option and the drain_newest_trailing_reset_abandons_the_pre_reset_unit_and_returns_none regression test.

executorQa.evidence: Executor QA/red-team lane agent://90-G002QaRedTeam verified every G002 obligation against source and the parent-run test artifact: reset-before-frame ordering, atomic overflow reset, generation-keyed recovery (wrap-safe counter, same-epoch aliasing rejected at three layers), TOCTOU atomicity via a real blocked-thread test, stale-epoch rejection, failed/no-output key structurally unable to clear recovery, real-AVFrame-only is_key, first-connection epoch adoption, pre-reset poisoning, and line-by-line capi.rs/header ABI parity. artifactRefs.description: Parent-run Rust test/lint evidence with named G002 adversarial tests

contractCoverage.obligation: Frame|Discontinuity carried in order with epoch; overflow reset atomically precedes retained data
Discontinuity flushes FFmpeg buffers, clears pending output, gates deltas
Only a successfully output matching-epoch decoded key acknowledges recovery (generation-keyed); failed/no-output key stays latched

surfaceEvidence.invocation: cargo test -p client-transport --lib (83 tests incl. generation/atomicity/aliasing)
cargo test -p app-native --features video --bins (83+6 tests incl. FFmpeg integration flush/synthetic-stream)

adversarialCases.scenario: Queue overflow while consumer blocked; generation counter u64 wrap
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Reset enqueued before retained frame under one lock; wrapped generation lands on 1, never the sentinel
Strict arrival order preserved; compat wait_pop never reorders

adversarialCases.scenario: Real FFmpeg reference chain across avcodec_flush_buffers
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Flush clears reference chain; garbage input never yields a frame

adversarialCases.scenario: Same-epoch burst discontinuities with an earlier key ack
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Stale generation ack rejected at queue, RxCore/ABI, and decode-state layers

adversarialCases.scenario: Failed or output-less key packet; delta mislabelled as key
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: No DecodeMeta constructed; recovery stays latched; is_key from real AVFrame only

adversarialCases.scenario: Decoded output from a superseded epoch; nonzero first-connection epoch
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Stale epoch rejected; first-seen epoch adopted instead of assuming zero

adversarialCases.scenario: Pre-reset unit in hand across a same-epoch reset, including trailing-reset drains
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Poisoned unit accounted but never decoded; trailing reset returns no frame
